description: Execute an arbitrary shell command (bash, sh) inside an isolated, hardware-virtualized MicroVM sandbox. Returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and execution latency.

command.description: The shell command to execute inside the MicroVM (e.g., 'python3 -c "print(2+2)"', 'npm test', 'git status')

sandbox_id.description: Optional existing sandbox ID. If omitted, an ephemeral sub-6ms sandbox will be provisioned automatically.

name: thanaton_exec_command
